notes.title: Level editor and Workshop released
notes.content:
Add level editor and workshop, where you can use your own creativity to design and upload levels.
More than ten new levels have been added, bringing the total number of levels to 108.

notes.title: V1.0.4 update instructions
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Has accelerated the speed of all animations in the game, and you can also choose the speed that suits you through the system settings.
[*] Some keyboard shortcuts have been adjusted, and you can also customize the shortcuts through the system settings .
[*] When controlling Weak Ghost and Smart Ghost, the number of elements to be carried can be directly set using the number keys, without increasing or decreasing them one by one.
[/list]
